name: עזרא תל אביב
description: מרחב אירועים פרטי ובר פרטי בפלורנטין, תל אביב. אירוע אחד בערב - כל החלל שייך לקבוצה אחת בלבד, עד 50 אורחים. הכל כלול: אוכל מהטאבון, בר קוקטיילים פתוח, סאונד, תאורה והפקה מלאה.
description_en: Exclusive private event space and private bar in Florentin, Tel Aviv. One event per evening - the entire space belongs to a single group, up to 50 guests. All-inclusive: taboon/chef food, open cocktail bar, sound, lighting and full production.

keyFacts.category: private event space / private bar / event venue
keyFacts.notA: not a banquet hall, not a restaurant open to the public
keyFacts.exclusivity: one event per evening; the entire venue is closed for a single group
bestFor: company events and team-building (אירועי חברה, גיבוש מחלקה)
included: sound system: two main speakers, subwoofer, four monitors and a mixer
projector and fold-out projection screen (no wall-mounted TV)
keyFacts.kosherNote: Not under kashrut supervision. The entire menu is dairy-vegetarian - no meat, no seafood.
keyFacts.parking: No on-site parking; paid parking lots nearby.
